1 · Table 1 entry 1
+→++

投料：4-isothiocyanato-1,3-diphenylpyrazolone 1a 1 equiv；phenyl allenone 2a 2.5 equiv；dichloromethane 1 mL；quinine 10 mol%

条件：r.t.，0.5 h；DCM，1 mL

操作：同 A1。

结果：少量产物 3aa：trace；收率 4aa：59%（分离）；收率 5aa：20%（分离）；ee 31%（HPLC）

结果说明：major_enantiomer Q1/Q4-series or racemate

构型：1a：构型归属 Candidate graph contains an unassigned tetrahedral C4 center; source gives no configuration.；2a：轴手性 The terminal CH2 end gives two identical substituents, so the depicted allene axis is not stereogenic on the candidate graph.；构型归属 Achiral status is a structure-derived statement for the candidate graph, not a source stereochemical assignment.
